scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a next-day optometrist visit to try Cartier frames, [X] builds a warm but polished one-degree outfit around a wool coat and schedules the visit for afternoon daylight, allowing each frame's appearance to be checked against familiar layers and outside the showroom mirror.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备第二天去验光师处试戴 Cartier 镜框时，[X]会在一摄氏度的天气里以羊毛大衣搭配保暖而利落的造型，并把到店时间安排在下午自然光较好的时段，比较不同镜框的风格离开展厅镜面、回到熟悉穿搭后是否仍然可信。
examples: using Classic when the frame should remain polished through ordinary repeat wear
using Vintage when a period reference works with the user's familiar coat without becoming costume-like
using Futuristic only when the statement survives natural light and does not depend on showroom staging

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At an open-air R&B stadium concert, [X] treats sunglasses as part of a comfortable streetwear look for arrival photos and the performance while checking that the same pair remains practical through security, crowd movement, heat, phone entry, and the late walk back to the car.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加露天 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会把太阳镜作为舒适街头造型和入场照片的一部分，同时检验同一副眼镜能否经受安检、人群移动、炎热、手机验票以及深夜走回停车处等真实环节。
examples: using Punk when one hard-edged cue connects naturally to the music and streetwear
using Biker when a close road-oriented impression also stays secure in a crowd
using Vintage when a specific R&B-era reference remains legible without becoming a costume

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While hosting an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five golf friends, [X] compares original group dress themes and their suggested eyewear, judging which style remains comfortable on the lawn, recognizable rather than costume-heavy, and coherent when many guests appear together in photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位高尔夫球友筹备户外午宴时，[X]会比较几套原创集体着装主题及其建议的眼镜造型，判断哪种风格既适合草坪活动、不会过度像戏服，又能在多人合影中保持统一且清晰可辨。
examples: using Vintage for a country-club reference carried by cat-eye sunglasses rather than a full costume
using Punk or Biker only when the rock-oriented group theme is actually selected
using Novelty when playful eyewear helps the group photograph without obstructing normal participation

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While packing for Dubai, [X] needs sunglasses to sit naturally beside modest daytime clothes, intense desert sun, very cold indoor air conditioning, beach cover-ups, and the smarter dress expected by glamorous restaurants, so the chosen style must work across several looks without becoming conspicuous in the wrong setting.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为迪拜行程打包时，[X]需要让太阳镜同时融入白天较为端庄的服装、强烈沙漠日照、室内低温空调、海滩罩衫以及精致餐厅要求的利落着装，因此风格既要跨越多种形象，也不能在不合适的场合显得突兀。
examples: using Classic when one restrained pair must bridge sightseeing and smart-casual dining
using Futuristic only when a sharper direction remains compatible with the rest of the packed wardrobe
not deriving style from UV protection alone

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a summer holiday in Italy, [X] packs sunglasses into a small wardrobe expected to feel chic and comfortable through hot streets, coastal stops, church dress codes, long walks, and visits to sustainable shops, choosing a versatile style that can repeat without forcing a separate outfit for every stop.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利暑期旅行准备精简行李时，[X]希望太阳镜能融入一套兼顾时髦与舒适的衣橱，并跨越炎热街道、海岸停留、教堂着装规范、长距离步行和可持续商店探访，无需每到一处就另换整套造型。
examples: using Classic when the pair must bridge many stops with minimal styling changes
using Vintage when a period reference complements local shopping without impersonating a destination stereotype
keeping beach sun protection separate from the style decision

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With no frame chosen yet and one hundred dollars available for computer glasses, [X] first separates prescription and all-day comfort needs from the desired appearance on the face, then compares styles that can remain suitable through repeated everyday screen use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一百美元总预算内购买用于电脑工作的眼镜、但尚未选定镜框时，[X]会先把处方与全天舒适需求同面部希望呈现的外观分开，再比较能够适应日常反复屏幕使用的不同风格。
examples: letting the user's stated identity open Classic, Punk, Vintage, Biker, Steampunk, Futuristic, or Novelty directions
preserving prescription, comfort, and total budget while the style target changes
not claiming that any suggested frame has already been selected

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After giving a friend sunglasses for his birthday because fashion is part of how he presents himself, [X] uses the friend's positive response to a currently popular style as concrete feedback while distinguishing that successful style match from [X]'s own habit of rarely wearing sunglasses.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 因为朋友常用时尚表达自己而在生日时送出一副太阳镜后，[X]会把朋友对当下流行款式的积极反应作为具体反馈，同时明确区分这次成功的风格匹配与[X]本人很少佩戴太阳镜的习惯。
examples: using the recipient's established self-presentation rather than the giver's taste
allowing any named style only when it matches the recipient's existing identity cues
treating the gifted sunglasses as concrete because the gift and reaction have already occurred

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a low-cost Rio beach trip, [X] needs sunglasses but avoids expensive or conspicuous valuables on the sand, choosing a pair that looks intentional with ordinary vacation clothes without advertising luxury or attracting attention during repeated beach use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划低预算的里约海滩旅行时，[X]虽然仍需要太阳镜，却会避免在沙滩上佩戴昂贵或显眼的贵重物品；眼镜应与普通度假穿搭协调，又不能在反复海滩使用中刻意彰显奢华或吸引注意。
examples: using Classic when restraint and repeatability matter more than novelty
rejecting a direction whose conspicuous identity conflicts with the user's stated safety strategy
not claiming ownership of the expensive sunglasses mentioned only as something to avoid

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a personal Tracer cosplay, [X] selects pilot or welding goggles to modify and attach to the character's headpiece, then judges whether the recognizable eyewear should read as future technology, retro machinery, or deliberate costume play without competing with the jacket and illuminated prop.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在完成个人 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会选定飞行员或焊接护目镜并计划改造后固定在头饰上，再判断这件标志性眼镜应呈现未来科技、复古机械还是有意的戏剧趣味，同时不与夹克和发光道具争夺视觉焦点。
examples: using Futuristic when the goggles reinforce the character's technology
using Steampunk only when the modified hardware intentionally foregrounds retro machinery
using Novelty when playful recognizability is more important than everyday wear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When seeking a memorable gift for a male friend, [X] considers high-quality sunglasses as a style-conscious gear upgrade but delays choosing the look until observing what the friend repeatedly wears, what feels generic or worn out, and whether a specialist visit or gift certificate would respect the recipient's own style better than a surprise frame.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 想为男性朋友准备令人难忘的礼物时，[X]会把高品质太阳镜视为兼具风格与实用性的装备升级；但在观察朋友反复佩戴的东西、哪些物品显得廉价或老旧之前，不急于决定造型，并比较去专业门店共同选择或送礼卡是否比盲选镜框更尊重对方自己的风格。
examples: letting the recipient's current wardrobe and self-presentation determine the style direction
using a shared fitting or gift certificate when a strong identity makes surprise selection risky
not inventing a purchased pair or inferring style from gender alone

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A commercial theme-park team develops transformation rooms and souvenir-photo costumes for several historical identities, comparing whether guest goggles should communicate restrained period service, recognizable vintage dress, or a deliberately steampunk machine-age fantasy while remaining practical for repeated public fitting.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一支商业主题乐园团队正在设计变装空间与纪念照服装，用于呈现几种历史身份；团队需要比较供游客试戴的护目镜应表达克制的时代服务形象、清晰可辨的复古装束，还是有意强化的蒸汽朋克机械幻想，同时保证其适合高频公共试戴。
examples: using Steampunk when gears and goggles intentionally create a machine-age fantasy
using Vintage when the eyewear supports a recognizable period without fantasy machinery
using Classic when restrained costume service should not dominate the guest portrait
